name: iter_arch_normal
description: ARCHITECTURE PERSPECTIVE, standard setting: six MLP shapes spanning tiny to wide, deep and bottleneck, crossed with the paper's three mix policies at the operating point. Capacity is the natural suspect behind the loop's failure mode - forgetting is what a round of continued training does to the input space it no longer rehearses, and how much survives should depend on how much network there is. Standard (2 x 64) is the operating point's own shape. n_model_params recorded per row. K=8, 15 seeds.
